name: Civilization Readers
description: A mini-site of 53 museum primers covering the Mediterranean and Near East, Asia, Africa (kingdoms and peoples alike), the Americas, and Oceania. Each reader shows a visual timeline (with a world-history ruler), high-level context, deeper period-by-period detail, a deep-dive masterpiece card, and a museum cheat sheet — including real gallery numbers, plus a spoken version of the 30-second quick read. Thirteen museums (the Met, four SF Bay Area museums, four Smithsonian museums, the British Museum, the Louvre, Berlin's Museum Island, and an extensible template) are structured internally as a graph — museums → galleries → civilizations → objects, plus typed relationship edges for trade, script, conquest and religious spread — and rendered as an interactive force-directed network with a time slider on routes.html. Also includes 90-minute "start here" tours, a how-to-read-a-label guide, a glossary, and a reference list. Mobile-first, works offline, installable, and has a dark/low-light mode for dim galleries.
